changes.comment: Take over a daemon startup reservation whose helper exited once 15 seconds have passed since that launch and nothing listens at the endpoint, and start the daemon again, instead of refusing every automatic start until `resetDaemonArtifactsAsync()`. Until then another launch is still refused at once. The startup helper now also releases its reservation for a daemon that another launch published while its own launcher exited. `inspectDaemonStartupReservation()` reports the `relaunchAfter` time.
